goal: Implement backend lane for redirecting demo: Phase 1 minimal execution-session APIs and non-blocking OCR/log compatibility, then Phase 2 minimal ai_jobs lifecycle and insight fallback without blocking core loop.

constraints.notes: Keep /v1/narrative and /v1/ocr/ingest compatibility. No hard dependency on external worker for Phase 1 completion.

acceptance: Phase 1 APIs are available with demo-safe minimum path: session start/focus end/reflect/today or equivalent compatibility path.
OCR ingest save path remains non-blocking and reflection completion is not blocked by OCR/AI delay or failure.
Phase 2 ai_jobs minimum states (queued/running/succeeded/failed) and insight fallback behavior are demonstrable without blocking core loop.
Backend lane publishes schema-valid result with commands/evidence paths.

risk.note: Introducing full async architecture too early can destabilize demo; implement only checklist-scoped minimal lifecycle.

next_actions: Implement and verify Phase 1 minimal API path first with compatibility checks.
Publish Phase 1 evidence and gate outcome before touching Phase 2 ai_jobs logic.
Implement Phase 2 minimal async lifecycle with rule-based fallback and publish schema-valid result.
